slides.label: MUTE ON DEMAND
headline: Done speaking?
Mute in a moment.
slides.body: Use the menu bar or a keyboard shortcut. Press again to restore the saved state.
slides.detail: Controls mute and input volume on supported devices.
slides.alt: Mutelet menu showing a muted microphone and the Unmute button

slides.label: PUSH TO TALK
headline: Hold to speak.
Release to mute.
slides.body: Keep your mic muted between turns. Hold your shortcut when you want to join the conversation.
slides.detail: Starts with F8. Choose a shortcut that works for you.
slides.alt: Mutelet menu explaining how to hold the shortcut to talk

slides.label: SEE YOUR MIC STATE
headline: Is your mic muted?
See at a glance.
slides.body: Check the on-screen HUD or persistent status. Adjust the size and position to suit your screen.
slides.detail: Push to Talk can also light the screen edges while you speak.
slides.alt: Display settings for the on-screen HUD and persistent status

slides.label: SET IT UP YOUR WAY
headline: Your usual mic.
Your way to work.
slides.body: Choose a mode and the inputs to control. Set Mutelet to open when you log in.
slides.detail: No audio recording. Settings stay on your Mac.
slides.alt: General settings for microphone mode, input target, and launch at login
